a.xlink:title: Deletes the selected unit after the user has confirmed it; refused while a composition uses it.
The panel has changed the document. Emitted after SceneDocument::changed().
Lists the units again and shows the selected one.
The unit is gone from the model. Emitted after the document is marked changed.
A chainage in kilometres as printf "%f" writes it, the form used in switch section ids.
True when more than one section matches the reference as a runtime id or base-block alias.
The one section with this runtime id; null when none or several have it.
